$comment: The vague JD: no certification, no named software, no industry, no location or time zone, no start date. The parser must leave the hard-filter lists empty rather than guess ('some accounting software' is not a requirement), keep the title as written, and still pull the three soft requirements out of the prose. Every resume passes its (empty) hard filters.

requirements.title: Finance & Ops person
must_haves: has done bookkeeping or accounting before (a couple of years is probably enough)
able to explain numbers to people who aren't finance people
nice_to_haves: Used any of the usual accounting or payroll tools
Interest in eventually building out a finance function
